policy: Canonical fixed-suite evaluation may exclude only explicitly enumerated non-target failures. Entries here were OBSERVED on the replay hosts; they were NOT run against upstream GOLD.

excluded_tests.rationale: Non-target test. GrazieInspectionTest downloads a language bundle at run time (LangDownloader.runDownload); on a host that cannot reach it the report says "Failed to download 'https://resources.jetbrains.com/grazie/model/language-tool/5.7/de-5.7.jar': Connect timed out". Fixed side only.

Non-target test. LatestTexifyVersionTest calls LatexErrorReportSubmitter.getLatestVersion(), an HTTP GET to the JetBrains plugin repository with a 1000 ms connect and read timeout; on a timeout it returns an empty object and the test asserts the version is not blank. Fixed side only; observed on the second host.
